Exchange/platform: Gate
Headline: Anthropic (ANT) Listing Trading Challenge :Trade Stocks for a Free ANT Draw 100% Win Rate
Start: 2026-11-20T08:00:00Z · End: 2026-11-27T08:00:00Z
Smallest threshold (parsed): 100 USD (trade)
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Once ANT is listed for trading, Gate will launch a 7-day trading challenge. After registering, users can earn draw chances by trading stocks and completing the first-time transfer, first trade, daily check-in, and cumulative trading volume tasks. Every valid draw wins one item from the prize pool, including ANT Stock Trial Funds, ANT tokens, and fee rebate vouchers. Prizes are limited and available until claimed.
Join Now
## Event Period: November 20, 2026, 8:00 – November 27, 2026, 8:00 (UTC)
## Lucky Draw: Complete Tasks, Win Stock Tokens and Fee Rebates
During the campaign, users earn draw entries by completing the following tasks:
Task Type | Completion Criteria | Draw Entries
First Transfer | Complete your first-ever transfer into your stock account during the campaign, with the first transfer ≥ $100 | 1 (max 1)
First Trade | Complete your first-ever stock trade during the campaign, with the first trade volume ≥ $100 | 1 (max 1)
Daily Check-in | Daily cumulative stock trading volume ≥ 1,000 | 1 (max 1 per day)
All-Users Trading | Cumulative stock trading volume reaches 500 / 10,000 / 50,000 / 100,000 | 1 / 3 / 6 / 10
- The prize pool is updated daily at 00:00 (UTC) ; once that day's prizes are drawn, unused draw entries roll over to the next prize-pool refresh. If all prizes are drawn on the final day, the campaign ends automatically.
## Important Notes
- Users must click “Join Now” on the campaign page to register and complete identity verification before registration. Participation may be unavailable in certain regions due to local laws or platform service restrictions.
- Only valid fills of the designated ANT products on Gate’s Stocks page, completed during the campaign after successful registration, will count. Unfilled or canceled orders, off-platform trades, asset transfers, and non-designated products are excluded.
- Trading volume equals buy turnover plus sell turnover. Currency conversion, fill times, and data records are determined by Gate’s system.
- Cumulative volume chances are awarded only for the highest tier reached and do not stack. Daily check-ins are counted by UTC+8 calendar day, up to 7 times; first transfer and first trade are each limited to once. Chances are issued after system verification; validity is shown on the campaign page.
- Every valid draw guarantees one prize from the pool. Product codes, face values, quantities, probabilities, usage scope, and validity are subject to the prize-pool table and voucher terms. Prizes are not redeemable for cash or transferable, except as required by law.
- Trades made using trial funds do not count toward cumulative trading volume or task tiers. Profit, loss, principal treatment, and withdrawal limits for trial-fund trades are governed by the product rules and voucher terms. Minimum tradable share quantity is subject to the product rules.
- Subscription-period tiered rewards and trading-period rewards are calculated separately. Eligible users may participate under the respective subscription-period rules, VIP airdrop plan, and Simple Earn product rules. The same trade cannot count toward multiple mutually exclusive Gate campaigns.
- Gate will review accounts, trading activity, and fund movements during the campaign. Prohibited conduct includes participating more than once using multiple accounts, using another person’s identity or submitting false verification documents, self-trading or wash trading, recycling on-chain funds, organizing schemes to claim rewards improperly, repeatedly transferring funds, and any other conduct that undermines the fairness of the campaign. If a violation is confirmed, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards. Sub-accounts are not eligible for this campaign. Market makers, corporate and institutional accounts, and agents are not eligible for this campaign.
- Before trading stocks, users must complete the relevant TradFi risk assessment and accept the applicable agreements.
- Rewards are expected to be distributed after the campaign ends and data verification is complete; timing will be announced on the campaign page. For task, draw, or distribution issues, contact official Gate customer support with account and campaign records; backend records will be used for verification.
- ANT is a newly listed security and may experience significant price volatility at launch. Listing time is subject to issuer and trading-platform announcements. If the listing is delayed, campaign dates will be adjusted and announced on the campaign page.
- Stocks and related products involve market, liquidity, foreign-exchange, and regulatory risks. This campaign is not investment advice, a promise of returns, or a recommendation of any stock. Participate prudently according to your risk tolerance.
- Gate may amend, suspend, or cancel the campaign as permitted by applicable laws and platform rules. Changes will be announced on the official campaign page. Users in restricted regions may not have access to all or part of the services.

Exchange/platform: Binance
Headline: Binance Earn: Enjoy Up to 5% APR with USDC and USDT Flexible Products (2026-11-22)
Start: 2026-11-22T00:00:00Z · End: 2026-12-11T23:59:00Z
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
Fellow Binancians,
Binance Earn is excited to renew the campaign for the USDC and USDT Simple Earn Flexible Products!
During the Promotion Period, eligible users who subscribe to USDC and USDT Flexible Products may enjoy up to 5% APR.
Promotion Period: 2026-11-22 00:00:00 (UTC) to 2026-12-11 23:59:59 (UTC)
## Offered Products
Product | User Status Eligibility | Total APR = Real-Time / Base APR + Bonus Tiered APR
USDC Flexible | Non-VIP Users | Real-Time APR (Subject to change, currently around 1.5%) | +3% Bonus Tiered APR (Tier 0 - 5,000 USDC)
VIP Users | +4% Bonus Tiered APR (Tier 0 - 50,000 USDC)
USDT Flexible | All Users | Real-Time APR (Subject to change, currently around 2%) | +3% Bonus Tiered APR (Tier 0 - 800 USDT)
Start Earning Now!
## Please Note
Only master accounts are eligible for the Bonus Tiered APR. Sub-accounts will not be included in the bonus reward calculation.
## Rewards Distribution:
Real-Time APR:Accrued and directly accumulated in users’ Earn Accounts every minute. Real-Time APR is subject to change every minute, please refer to the respective product page(s) for full information.
Bonus Tiered APR: Distributed to users’ Spot Accounts every day. The first reward will be given the day after accrual starts (two days after subscription). For more calculation details, please refer to this FAQ.
It may take up to 2 hours for newly upgraded VIP users to view the Bonus Tiered APR.
Once the Special APR is visible, users must make a new subscription (including Auto-Subscribe) to activate the promotional APR — prior subscriptions will not activate it.
Rewards are limited. Once the rewards pool is exhausted, Bonus Tiered APR will no longer be available to new participants.
During the Activity Period, users who borrow stablecoins via Binance Loans or Margin and subscribe to the promotion products for arbitrage will not be eligible for Bonus Tiered APR rewards. Any Bonus Tiered APR rewards already distributed will be deducted.
## Terms & Conditions
Only users who complete identity verification during the Promotion Period can qualify for rewards in the Promotion.
The products or features referred to above may not be available in your region. Users are responsible for informing themselves about and observing any restrictions and/or requirements imposed with respect to the access to and use of Binance services in each country from which the services are accessed.
Changes to the Binance Simple Earn Rewards Rate will be published on the Platform from time to time. Please refer to Binance Simple Earn Terms & Conditions and Risk Warning for more information prior to using Binance Simple Earn.
## Rewards:
Bonus Tiered APR is offered as an additional reward on top of Real-Time APR.
Bonus Tiered APR accrual is based on a daily random snapshot of your Flexible Product balance (taken between 00:00:00 - 23:59:59 UTC).
Any redemption of Flexible Products made during the daily reward accrual window (from 00:00:00 (UTC) to 00:00:00 (UTC) of the following day) will stop the accrual of Bonus Tiered APR rewards on the redeemed amount for that day.
Redemptions of Flexible Products will be processed starting with assets that have accrued rewards. Users can check the rewards history from the Earn History.
All users who hold open positions for USDC and USDT Flexible Products will receive both Real-Time APR and Bonus Tiered APR rewards during the Promotion Period. Once the Promotion ends, users will be entitled to Real-Time APR rewards only.
A large amount of redemption requests might delay redemption temporarily. Redemptions may resume upon return of liquidity.
Users can view their Flexible Products assets by going to Assets > Earn > Simple Earn.
Redemption time for Flexible Products subscriptions: Instant.
There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise.
